purpose: Nominative fair-use client trust badges for GS Industrial 'Confían en nosotros' section. Logos are unmodified in color; only trimmed of surrounding whitespace/padding and resized (no recoloring).

logos.original_format: SVG (rasterized to PNG at up to 600px, transparent background)
logos.license_note: Wikimedia Commons; simple/basic geometric shapes and text (below threshold of originality) but the Techint wordmark and pictogram may be a protected trademark in some jurisdictions. Used here nominatively to represent a real client relationship, not as a claim of affiliation.
Wikimedia Commons, categorized as logo of a state-owned Argentine company. Trademark rights may apply; used nominatively.
Wikimedia Commons, current unified brand wordmark for the Argentine state railway group. Trademark rights may apply; used nominatively.
Wikimedia Commons, sourced originally from edenor.com; current logo confirmed via English Wikipedia infobox. Trademark rights may apply; used nominatively.

logos.original_format: PNG, native resolution kept (not upscaled), transparent background
logos.license_note: Downloaded directly from the company's own official domain (reconstruccion.com.ar). Note: this is their public-facing commercial brand 'Forever Pipe' (Reconstrucción Caños S.A. trades under this name for pipe rehabilitation services) -- no separate 'Reconstrucción Caños' wordmark logo was found on their site; this is the only official logo asset available. Resolution is modest (native site asset); consider a text-based fallback if a larger badge size is needed.

Downloaded directly from the company's own official domain (chediack.com.ar). Note: this is the color ISOTIPO (symbol only, red/gray interlocking arrows) -- the site's only full isologotipo (symbol + 'CHEDIACK' wordmark) asset is white-on-transparent and would be invisible on a white card, so it was not used. If the wordmark is needed, consider a text-based fallback reading 'CHEDIACK' next to this symbol.
